title: Trinity Ritual Context Schema
description: Per-ritual typed-placeholder catalog. Authority: TRINITY_RITUAL_CONSTITUTION_V1_1_RC.md Article XVI (Template Injection Protection). One file per ritual at .ai/rituals/<ritual>/context.schema.json. Declares which {{type:identifier}} placeholders the write template may consume; kernel uses this to type-check substitution and preserve user input as data, never instruction.

ritual.description: Must match parent directory name and ritual.contract.json.ritual.

identifier.description: Dotted lower-snake_case identifier. Used as {{type:identifier}} in write.template.md.

type.description: Article XVI typed-field enumeration. Kernel escapes substitution by type.

required.description: If true, write template MUST consume this placeholder; missing context aborts the ritual.

source.description: Optional hint about where the value originates (e.g. 'session.meta', 'plan_envelope.goal', 'user.answer.q1').
